meta.name: review-large-pr
meta.description: Review a large pull request (30+ changed files) using chunked parallel review with synthesis. Each chunk is audited by the audit-* specialists in parallel, then synthesized into one consolidated report. Use when a PR is too large for a single audit pass.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 并行分块审查大型PR，合成统一报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要审查超过30个文件的PR
copy.tagline_en: Review large PRs with chunked parallel audit and synthesis
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often review pull requests with 30+ changed files

howto.what: 能自动把大型 PR 拆成小块，并行调用多个专家审查每个块，最后综合生成统一的审查报告。
howto.when: 当你请求审查一个包含30个以上变更文件的大型拉取请求时触发。
